expectations.text: DSL validates cleanly with the Structurizr CLI (Docker) — or, if Docker is unavailable, the response says plainly it was not validated
Each microservice is a `group` (or group archetype) of containers — its API plus its database schema — inside ONE software system, not three separate software systems
expectations.evidence: `group "Catálogo"`, `group "Pedidos"`, `group "Pagamentos"`, each API + schema container, all inside `mercadin`.

expectations.text: The BFF is modeled as a container on the container view (custom-built, carries business logic), not as an infrastructureNode
expectations.evidence: `bff = container "BFF" … "Node.js"` on the container view, with the app → BFF → services relationships.

expectations.text: The ALB is an infrastructureNode in the production environment, with the app→BFF relationship rerouted through it via `-/>` (or an equivalent explicit reroute); the ALB does not appear on the container view
expectations.evidence: `alb = infrastructureNode "ALB"` under `aws`; `mercadin.app -/> mercadin.bff` and three `bff -/> service` reroutes via `aws.alb`; ALB not in the model's container list.

expectations.text: Docker and Fargate appear only in the deployment model (AWS → ECS/Fargate → Docker container → instance), never as containers
expectations.evidence: `ecs = deploymentNode "Amazon ECS" "" "AWS Fargate"` → 'Task X' nodes with technology 'Docker Container' → instanceOf; nothing Docker/Fargate at container level.

expectations.text: Adyen is an external software system; no invented architecture beyond the spec (cosmetic defaults allowed)
expectations.evidence: `adyen = softwareSystem` tagged External; BFF→services-via-ALB flagged as an assumption; replicas/RDS left unstated.
